g.text: What the hospital's first accesses are made of

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8a8a

g.text: A first access is one user opening one patient's chart for the first time in a week, self-access left out. Misuse rows in blue and below the dashed line. The case set

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8a8a

g.text: takes every misuse access and a fixed number of each legitimate kind, and population figures are weighted back by kind.
